title: Self-adjointness of the Gaussian generator
statement: Let $n\ge0$ and let $f,g,u,v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$. Suppose $u$ is the Gaussian generator of $f$ and $v$ is the Gaussian generator of $g$. Then $\int f v\,d\gamma_n=\int u g\,d\gamma_n$, where $\gamma_n$ is the product standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$.
